mobile-ritual.text:
Skip to main content

THE RITUAL

Four formulas.
One complete ritual.

Effective skincare is a sequence, not a single product. Each step prepares the skin for the next, morning and evening.

01
Cleanse
02
Treat
03
Revive
04
Restore

A single extraordinary product can transform a moment. A complete ritual can transform skin.

01

Step 1:Cleanse

Micellar Water All‑in‑One Cleanser

Micelles lift away make-up, impurities and pollutants, while Aloe Vera, Tamarind Seed Extract and a Skin Barrier Optimizer preserve comfort and prepare the skin for Advanced Repair Serum. It cleanses, tones and refreshes in one step, without rinsing or residue.

AMOUNT
One soaked cotton pad
WHEN
Morning and evening
HOW TO APPLY
WHO IT SUITS

Discover the Micellar Water
€55, · 150 ml

02

Step 2:Treat

Advanced Repair Serum

The most concentrated formula of the ritual. Micro-encapsulated caviar extract and Syn®-Coll peptide support a firmer, smoother-looking complexion. Its silky, non-oily texture absorbs quickly, so the steps that follow layer without heaviness.

AMOUNT
Two to three drops
WHEN
Morning and evening
HOW TO APPLY
WHO IT SUITS

Discover the Advanced Repair Serum
€150, · 30 ml

03

Step 3:Revive

Revitalizing Eye Cream

Calibrated for the thinnest skin of the face. It melts on contact, helps diminish the appearance of dark circles and smooths the look of fine lines around the eyes, leaving the contour hydrated and softly replenished.

AMOUNT
A grain of rice per eye
WHEN
Morning and evening
HOW TO APPLY
WHO IT SUITS

Discover the Revitalizing Eye Cream
€145, · 15 ml

04

Step 4:Restore

24h Regeneration Cream

The final step seals the ritual. A silky, velvet-textured cream that locks in moisture and the serum and eye-care steps before it, with a caviar lipid complex that supports the skin’s barrier: lasting hydration and comfort, day and night.

AMOUNT
A pea‑sized amount
WHEN
Morning and evening
HOW TO APPLY
WHO IT SUITS

Discover the 24h Regeneration Cream
€150, · 50 ml

Why the order matters

Skincare is not merely about ingredients; it is about the architecture of application. Always in this order, from the lightest texture to the richest: each step prepares the skin for the one that follows.

LIGHTEST
RICHEST

01
Cleanse
Water

Prepare

The cleanser lifts make‑up and the day’s impurities without rinsing, leaving the skin clean and comfortable for what follows.

02
Treat
Fluid

Concentrate

The lightest, most concentrated texture goes on first, onto clean skin, and is given a minute to absorb.

03
Revive
Light cream

Precision

The eye contour receives its own formula, calibrated for the thinnest skin of the face, where a face cream may feel too rich.

04
Restore
Rich cream

Seal

The richest texture comes last, sealing in the layers beneath it with lasting hydration and comfort.

At the heart of every step: caviar extract from sustainably farmed Siberian sturgeon (Acipenser baerii), formulated in Zug, Switzerland.

Explore Swiss science
Clinical studies

Finish with a broad-spectrum SPF 50+.

Cleanse
Lift the day’s make‑up and SPF.
02
Treat
Two or three drops, unhurried.
03
Revive
Patted along the orbital bone.
04
Restore
Your overnight treatment.

Allow the cream to absorb fully before sleeping.

THE RITUAL

Four formulas.
One complete ritual.

Effective skincare is a sequence, not a single product. Each step prepares the skin for the next, morning and evening.

01
Cleanse
02
Treat
03
Revive
04
Restore

A single extraordinary product can transform a moment. A complete ritual can transform skin.

01

Step 1:Cleanse

Micellar Water All‑in‑One Cleanser

Micelles lift away make-up, impurities and pollutants, while Aloe Vera, Tamarind Seed Extract and a Skin Barrier Optimizer preserve comfort and prepare the skin for Advanced Repair Serum. It cleanses, tones and refreshes in one step, without rinsing or residue.

AMOUNT
One soaked cotton pad
WHEN
Morning and evening
HOW TO APPLY
WHO IT SUITS

Discover the Micellar Water
€55, · 150 ml

02

Step 2:Treat

Advanced Repair Serum

The most concentrated formula of the ritual. Micro-encapsulated caviar extract and Syn®-Coll peptide support a firmer, smoother-looking complexion. Its silky, non-oily texture absorbs quickly, so the steps that follow layer without heaviness.

AMOUNT
Two to three drops
WHEN
Morning and evening
HOW TO APPLY
WHO IT SUITS

Discover the Advanced Repair Serum
€150, · 30 ml

03

Step 3:Revive

Revitalizing Eye Cream

Calibrated for the thinnest skin of the face. It melts on contact, helps diminish the appearance of dark circles and smooths the look of fine lines around the eyes, leaving the contour hydrated and softly replenished.

AMOUNT

WHEN
Morning and evening
HOW TO APPLY
WHO IT SUITS

04

Step 4:Restore

24h Regeneration Cream

The final step seals the ritual. A silky, velvet-textured cream that locks in moisture and the serum and eye-care steps before it, with a caviar lipid complex that supports the skin’s barrier: lasting hydration and comfort, day and night.

Why the order matters

Skincare is not merely about ingredients; it is about the architecture of application. Always in this order, from the lightest texture to the richest: each step prepares the skin for the one that follows.

LIGHTEST
RICHEST

01
Cleanse
Water

Prepare

The cleanser lifts make‑up and the day’s impurities without rinsing, leaving the skin clean and comfortable for what follows.

02
Treat
Fluid

Concentrate

The lightest, most concentrated texture goes on first, onto clean skin, and is given a minute to absorb.

03
Revive
Light cream

Precision

The eye contour receives its own formula, calibrated for the thinnest skin of the face, where a face cream may feel too rich.

04
Restore
Rich cream

Seal

The richest texture comes last, sealing in the layers beneath it with lasting hydration and comfort.

At the heart of every step: caviar extract from sustainably farmed Siberian sturgeon (Acipenser baerii), formulated in Zug, Switzerland.
